description: Predominantly response gain. Two solid CRFs with little/no horizontal (contrast) shift: attended is scaled UP to a plateau ~0.85, ignored to a LOWER plateau ~0.60, and they DO NOT converge at high contrast (sustained vertical separation ~0.25 = the response-gain signature). Dashed percent-modulation curve on the right axis DESCENDS MONOTONICALLY: ~99% at low contrast, through ~60% near the crossing (~x=0.09), continuing DOWN to a low ~42% plateau at high contrast (it does NOT recover). Sanity: high-contrast %mod ~= (attended-ignored)/ignored ~= (0.86-0.60)/0.60 ~= 43%. Shared sub-1.0 scale with 2A: 2B's attended plateau (~0.85) is HIGHER than 2A's (~0.62) - that height difference is the figure's scientific claim.

provenance.figure_type: line/curve CRF, log-x; two solid CRFs (left axis 0-1) + one dashed attentional-modulation curve (right axis 0-100)
provenance.tool_rationale: ONE targeted re-trace of the dashed percent_modulation curve only. The dashed is style/region-separable from the two solid CRFs and is the lowest dark line at high contrast, so trace_darkest_in_band in a moving band that follows the dashed isolates it cleanly. Right-axis calibration shares the same pixel rows as the left axis (frame 0 at row 332, 100/1.0 at row 41).

calibration.frame_source: panel 306x371 px; left axis col~39, right axis col~257, bottom frame row 332 = 0/0.0, top frame row 41 = 1.0/100 (matches independent audit calibration)

per_curve.attended: UNCHANGED from prior digitization (audited FAITHFUL: plateau ~0.86)
per_curve.unattended: UNCHANGED from prior digitization (audited FAITHFUL: plateau ~0.60)
per_curve.percent_modulation: RE-TRACED this pass. trace_darkest_in_band column-by-column in a band following the dashed from top-left down to its high-contrast plateau. Monotone descent: row ~64 (col 54, ~92%) -> row ~158 (col 144, ~60% at the crossing x~0.09) -> row ~210 (cols 224-248, ~42% plateau). Low-x anchor x=0.011 set to ~99% from faint dashed pixels at rows 42-44 in cols 45-51 (emerging just under the 100 line). High-contrast plateau confirmed at pixel row ~210 -> 41.8-42.3% across cols 200-248.

provenance.normalization: paper shared sub-1.0 scale (solids), unchanged; dashed on independent right axis 0-100, anchored to labelled 0 and 100 (same rows as left 0 and 1).
caveats: Fix scope: only percent_modulation was changed. attended/unattended solids untouched (prior audit found them faithful).

Dashed low-contrast head (x<0.02) is partly hidden against the top frame / 100 line; the x=0.011 -> 99% anchor is read from faint top-left pixels (rows 42-44) and is the least pixel-anchored point. The monotone-descending body (x>=0.04) and the ~42% high-contrast plateau are well pixel-supported.
x has no numeric ticks; x_range [0.01, 1.0] inherited from the frame (not independently checkable), consistent with the prior digitization and the audit.
Dashed has gaps (it is a dashed line); some columns dropped as expected. Centroid reads taken at columns where a dashed segment is present.
